cd "$(pwd)"
hops trino tables iceberg --no-verify --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -40

cd "$(pwd)"
hops trino schemas iceberg --no-verify --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -20

cd "$(pwd)"
hops trino tables iceberg.mlpabef6f3d_featurestore --no-verify --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -20

cd "$(pwd)"
mkdir -p .tmp
read -r -d '' Q <<'SQL'
WITH scores AS (
  SELECT u.user_id AS user_id, i.item_id AS item_id,
         (u.e1*i.e1+u.e2*i.e2+u.e3*i.e3+u.e4*i.e4+u.e5*i.e5+u.e6*i.e6+u.e7*i.e7+u.e8*i.e8) AS score
  FROM iceberg.mlpabef6f3d_featurestore.user_embeddings_1 u
  CROSS JOIN iceberg.mlpabef6f3d_featurestore.item_embeddings_1 i
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM iceberg.mlpabef6f3d_featurestore.interactions_1 x
    WHERE x.user_id = u.user_id AND x.item_id = i.item_id
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT user_id, item_id, score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY score DESC, item_id ASC) AS rnk
  FROM scores
)
SELECT user_id || '#' || CAST(rnk AS VARCHAR) AS rec_id, user_id, CAST(rnk AS INTEGER) AS "rank", item_id
FROM ranked WHERE rnk <= 5 ORDER BY user_id, rnk
SQL
hops sql "$Q" --no-verify --quiet --json --limit 0 2>/dev/null > .tmp/recs.json
echo "exit=$?"
wc -c .tmp/recs.json
head -c 600 .tmp/recs.json
